svg.aria-label: ChartWell: A private, offline-first health record for Android. Medicines, vitals, doctor visits and about 100 lab tests in 13 panels, with on-device OCR. Nothing leaves the phone unless you ask. Built with .NET MAUI 9, C#, SQLite, SkiaSharp, xUnit.
